description_en: Queries the approval details of a template after you submit a template application. You can view the approval status of the template
description_zh: 申请模板后，通过此接口查询模板审核详情，可查看模板审核状态
name: GetSmsTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The code of the SMS template.

- Obtain the SMS template code from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807431.html operation.
- View the SMS template code on the [Templates](https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template) page
parameters.help_zh:
短信模板Code。

- 在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807431.html接口的返回参数中获取短信模板Code。
- 在[模板管理](https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template)页面查看短信模板Code
parameters.name: template_code
